title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
slides: Can a pocket gadget defeat Russia's drones?
Ukraine's new device targets drone camera sensors directly
It blinds drones using their own lens optics, not jamming
Soldiers can deploy it without special training or power
Ask your defense contact if this tech is field-tested
thread_text:
1. A Pocket Drone Killer?

Ukraine has developed a handheld device that takes down Russian drones by blinding their camera sensors, not by jamming signals. Soldiers can carry it and use it without special training.

2. How It Blinds Drones

The device uses the drone's own lens optics against it, overloading the camera sensor with light. This forces the drone to lose visual guidance and crash or abort its mission.

3. No Training, No Power Needed

Soldiers can deploy it right out of the box, with no special training or external power source required. This makes it ideal for fast-moving frontline situations.

4. Not Jamming, But Blinding

Unlike electronic warfare that disrupts radio signals, this tool directly attacks the drone's vision. That means it works even against drones that are immune to jamming.

5. Is This Tech Battle-Tested?

Ask your defense contact if this device has been field-tested in real combat. If not, demand proof before relying on it.
